tasks.title: Service Banner & Script Scan
tasks.description: Probe the exact FTP daemon version and run default NSE enumeration scripts to detect anonymous access and configuration flags.

tasks.title: FTPS / TLS Certificate Inspection
tasks.description: Check if Explicit FTPS (AUTH TLS) is supported and dump the certificate details to identify hostnames, internal domains, or emails.

tasks.title: Anonymous CLI Connection
tasks.description: Attempt login using anonymous:anonymous or blank credentials. Use passive mode (-p) if active mode data connections fail.

tasks.title: Anonymous Web Browser Access
tasks.description: Browse the FTP root via a web browser for rapid directory exploration and inline document viewing.

tasks.title: Recursive Anonymous Mirroring (Wget)
tasks.description: Mirror the entire directory tree locally in one pass without navigating the interactive prompt.

tasks.title: List Hidden Files & Perms
tasks.description: List files with detailed attributes and show dotfiles (.bashrc, .ssh, .htaccess, web.config) that standard listings hide.

tasks.title: Safe Binary Download
tasks.description: Switch transfer mode to binary before retrieving files to prevent corruption of binaries, archives, or keys, and disable prompts for bulk gets.

tasks.title: Write Permissions & Web Root Test
tasks.description: Test write privileges by uploading a probe file, then check port 80/443 to see if the FTP directory maps directly to the web server root.

tasks.title: GTFOBins Client Shell Breakout
tasks.description: If operating an interactive FTP client session locally, verify escape mechanisms to spawn a local subshell.

tasks.title: Extract Document Metadata (Usernames)
tasks.description: Even when downloaded PDFs/Office docs have no useful content, their metadata (Author, Creator, Company) frequently leaks valid usernames or naming conventions for later password spraying.

tasks.title: NetExec / CME Password Spray
tasks.description: Spray known user lists against the FTP service using your custom and standard wordlists.

tasks.title: Hydra Wordlist Spray
tasks.description: Multi-threaded brute force against the FTP service using discovered usernames.

tasks.title: Common / Default Account Testing
tasks.description: Quick check for typical vendor defaults, test accounts, and paired credentials.
